lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 1. Greetings & Introductions
examples: My name is Tom.
Nice to meet you, Anna.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 2. I am / You are
examples: I am a student.
Are you happy today?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 3. He / She / It
examples: He is my friend.
Is she your teacher?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 4. We / They
examples: We are a team.
Are they your classmates?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 5. Possessive adjectives
examples: This is my book.
Is that your toy?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 6. Articles a / an / the
examples: It is an apple.
This is the table.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 7. Numbers & Colors
examples: It is blue.
I see three books.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 8. There is / There are
examples: There is a desk in the room.
Are there any chairs?
conversation: Is there a bed in the room?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 9. Prepositions of place
examples: The cat is under the table.
The bag is between two chairs.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 10. Review & Speaking: Foundation Check
grammar_patterns: My name is ____ and I am a ____.
examples: My name is Alex and I am a student.
There is a book in my room.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 11. Present Simple (I / You)
examples: I read every day.
Do you play after school?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 12. Present Simple (He / She)
examples: She reads every day.
Does he study at home?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 13. Negatives
examples: I do not watch TV at night.
He does not play football.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 14. Questions
examples: Where do you live?
Why do you study English?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 15. Daily routine
examples: I wake up at seven.
I usually study in the evening.
conversation: What do you do in the morning?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 16. Family
examples: This is my grandma.
These are my parents.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 17. Home
grammar_patterns: Is there a ____ in your room?
examples: There is a sofa in the living room.
Is there a TV in your room?
conversation: There is a TV in my room.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 18. Food & Preferences
grammar_patterns: What do you like to eat / drink?
examples: I like fruit.
I do not like fish.
conversation: What do you like to eat?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 19. Animals & Adjectives
examples: The dog is big and fast.
My favorite animal is a horse.
conversation: The dog is big and fast.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 20. Review & Speaking: About Me
examples: I can speak English.
Tomorrow I am going to practice more.
conversation: I study at school and play with my friends.
What do you like to eat?
I can read and speak English.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 21. Past Simple (was / were)
examples: I was happy yesterday.
Were they at home?
conversation: I’m fine, thank you. And you?
Was your brother at home yesterday?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 22. Past Simple (regular verbs)
examples: I played yesterday.
Did you watch a movie?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 23. Past Simple (irregular verbs)
examples: I went to the park.
She ate lunch at home.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 24. Time expressions (past)
examples: I watched TV last night.
Did you study last week?
conversation: What did you do last night?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 25. Can / Can’t (ability)
examples: I can swim, but I cannot drive yet.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 26. Must / Mustn’t (rules)
examples: We must listen in class.
You must not be late.
conversation: What must we do at school?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 27. Future: going to
grammar_patterns: She is going to ____ this weekend.
examples: I am going to visit my friend tomorrow.
conversation: What are you going to do tomorrow?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 28. Countable / Uncountable nouns
examples: I have an apple.
Do we have any milk?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 29. Much / Many
examples: How many books do you have?
How much water do we need?
conversation: How many friends do you have?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 30. Comparatives: Making choices
grammar_patterns: The ____ is cheaper / more expensive than the ____.
The ____ is safer / easier / harder than the ____.
I think ____ is more useful than ____.
examples: This phone is more expensive than that phone.
This task is harder than the first task.
conversation: Which game is more exciting, this one or that one?
I think this game is more exciting.
Because the levels are harder and the prizes are better.
Is it more difficult than the old game?
Yes, but it is more interesting.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 31. Superlatives: The best choice
grammar_patterns: He / She is the fastest ____ in the ____.
My ____ is the highest in the ____.
His / Her ____ is the lowest today.
Who is the fastest / strongest / smartest ____?
examples: This is the best option.
This level is the hardest one.
conversation: Which level is the hardest for you?
The final level is the hardest.
Who is the best player in your team?
Max is the best player. He has the highest score.
No, but I am the most careful player.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 32. Present Continuous: What is happening now?
lessons.topic: Present Continuous: What is happening now?
examples: I am building a house now.
They are searching for the key.
conversation: I am building a secret room.
No, my friends are helping me.
Not yet. We are still preparing.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 33. Present Simple vs Present Continuous
grammar_patterns: At the moment he / she is ____.
We often ____, but today we are ____.
They never ____, but now they are ____.
examples: I usually play after school, but now I am studying.
She often reads, but today she is watching a video.
conversation: What do you usually do after school?
I usually play Roblox with my friends.
I am doing my English task.
Do you always study in the evening?
No, sometimes I study in the morning.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 34. Prepositions of time: Planning your week
lessons.topic: Prepositions of time: Planning your week
examples: I have English at six o'clock.
We practice on Saturday.
conversation: It is on Monday and Wednesday.
Do you play games after the lesson?
No, I usually do homework in the evening.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 35. Directions & Places: Finding the way
grammar_patterns: How can I get to the ____?
examples: Turn right at the traffic light.
The shop is opposite the school.
conversation: Excuse me, how can I get to the library?
Go straight and turn left at the corner.
No, it is next to the park.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 36. Extended Questions
grammar_patterns: How long does it take to ____?
How far is the ____ from here?
What kind of ____ do you like?
examples: How often do you practice English?
What kind of games do you like?
conversation: How often do you play this game?
I play it three times a week.
What kind of levels do you like?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 37. Adverbs of manner: How do you do it?
lessons.topic: Adverbs of manner: How do you do it?
examples: She speaks clearly.
We finished the task quickly.
conversation: Can you explain it more slowly?
Do I need to speak loudly?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 38. Like / love / hate + -ing
examples: I enjoy building maps.
She hates waiting for the game to start.
conversation: What do you enjoy doing online?
Yes, but I don't like losing.
Because I can create something new.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 39. Invitations & Requests
examples: Could you explain the task?
Would you like to join our team?
conversation: Would you like to join our team?
We are building a new map.
Yes, follow me and listen carefully.
Great. Can I borrow some blocks?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 40. Review & Speaking: My past, my plans, my day
lessons.topic: Review & Speaking: My past, my plans, my day
grammar_patterns: I can ____ well, but I need to improve ____.
conversation: I practiced English and played with my team.
What are you going to do tomorrow?
I am going to finish a challenge.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 41. Past Continuous: A moment in the past
lessons.topic: Past Continuous: A moment in the past
examples: I was playing when my friend called.
They were waiting while it was raining.
conversation: What were you doing at seven yesterday?
No, my friends were helping me.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 42. Past Simple vs Past Continuous
examples: I was running when I fell.
While we were building, the door opened.
conversation: I was running when I fell.
He was searching for the exit.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 43. Present Perfect: Experience
examples: I have won a competition before.
She has never visited another country.
conversation: Have you ever won a competition?
Have you finished your new project yet?
No, I haven't finished it yet.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 44. Present Perfect vs Past Simple
examples: I have completed two tasks today.
I completed one task yesterday.
conversation: Have you finished the project yet?
Have you shown it to the teacher?
Not yet. I will show it today.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 45. For / Since
grammar_patterns: He / She has played this game for ____.
We have known each other since ____.
Have you ____ for a long time?
examples: I have studied English for two years.
We have known each other since childhood.
conversation: How long have you studied English?
I have studied English for two years.
How long have you played Roblox?
Have you known Max for a long time?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 46. Future Forms: Will / Going to
grammar_patterns: He / She is going to ____ later.
examples: I think the task will be difficult.
I am going to practice later.
conversation: What are you going to do after class?
I am going to finish my project.
Do you think it will be hard?
Yes, I promise I will show it.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 47. Zero Conditional
grammar_patterns: If you press the ____, the ____ opens.
examples: If you heat ice, it melts.
If you press the button, the door opens.
conversation: What happens if you press this button?
What happens if you touch fire?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 48. First Conditional
grammar_patterns: If he / she ____, he / she will ____.
examples: If I practice, I will improve.
If we hurry, we won't miss the game.
conversation: What will happen if we don't practice?
What will happen if we work together?
If I help you, will you help me later?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 49. Should: Giving advice
examples: You should rest.
We should check the answer before we send it.
conversation: I am tired and I can't focus.
You should take a short break.
No, but you should rest for ten minutes.
What should I do after that?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 50. Review & Speaking: A strange day
grammar_patterns: If it happens again, I will ____.
conversation: Tell me about your strange day.
I was walking home when I heard a loud sound.
I asked my friend for help.
What will you do next time?
I will charge my phone before I go out.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 51. Passive Voice: Present Simple
examples: This game is made for students.
These toys are sold online.
conversation: What is this tool used for?
They are made in a factory.
Yes, English is spoken in class.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 52. Passive Voice: Past Simple
examples: The map was created by our team.
The window was broken yesterday.
conversation: It was created by a small team.
Yes, they were added this month.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 53. Advanced Comparisons
grammar_patterns: That ____ is a little worse than ____.
This idea is less useful than ____.
He / She is more confident than before.
examples: This answer is much better than the first one.
She is more confident than before.
conversation: Is your new project better than the old one?
It is more creative and more useful.
A little, but I can explain it clearly.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 54. Too / Enough
grammar_patterns: He / She is strong enough to ____.
We are not ready enough to ____.
examples: This level is too difficult.
We are not ready enough to start.
conversation: Not yet. We are not ready enough.
Yes, it is too difficult for beginners.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 55. Gerund vs Infinitive
examples: I enjoy learning English.
I decided to practice speaking.
conversation: What do you want to learn?
I want to learn how to explain my ideas.
What do you plan to do today?
I plan to finish my project.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 56. Relative Clauses: who / which / that
grammar_patterns: Do you know a place where ____?
The game that I like is ____.
examples: A teacher is a person who explains things.
This is the tool that I use.
conversation: Who is the player that helped you?
It is Max. He is the player who knows the map.
What is the tool that you need?
I need the tool that opens the door.
Is this the game that you like?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 57. Reported Speech: Statements
examples: She said that she was tired.
The teacher explained that the task was important.
conversation: He said that he was busy.
She explained that we needed to work in pairs.
Yes, he promised that he would help us.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 58. Used to
grammar_patterns: I used to ____ when I was ____.
examples: I used to play outside.
She used to collect toys.
conversation: What did you use to do after school?
Did you use to play computer games?
Not often. I used to watch cartoons.
Sometimes, but now I prefer games.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 59. Question Tags
grammar_patterns: He / She can ____, can't he / she?
You will help me, won't you?
examples: You like English, don't you?
It is difficult, isn't it?
conversation: You finished the task, didn't you?
You will help me next time, won't you?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 60. Review & Speaking: Life experience
grammar_patterns: I used to ____, but now I ____.
conversation: What is your best English experience?
I have already presented a project in English.
Yes, but I became more confident.
I should improve my speaking speed.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 61. Second Conditional
grammar_patterns: If he / she knew ____, he / she would ____.
examples: If I had more time, I would practice more.
If I were rich, I would travel.
conversation: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
I would travel around the world.
Yes, I would buy a big house.
If you could choose any job, what would you choose?
I would become a game designer.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 62. Wish
grammar_patterns: He / She wishes he / she could ____.
What do you wish you could ____?
examples: I wish I could speak faster.
She wishes she had more time.
conversation: What do you wish you could do?
I wish I could speak English confidently.
Because I want to explain my ideas better.
Do you wish you had more practice?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 63. Phrasal Verbs: Basic actions
grammar_patterns: Pick up the ____ and put down the ____.
examples: Please sit down.
Can you turn on the light?
conversation: Can you turn on the computer?
I am looking for it now.
Yes, open it and sit down.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 64. Articles: a / an / the / zero article
lessons.topic: Articles: a / an / the / zero article
grammar_patterns: I go to school / work / home.
Can you give me some advice?
examples: I need a pencil.
I like music.
The internet is useful for learning.
conversation: Do you use the internet for English?
Yes, the internet is useful for practice.
Can you give me some advice?

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 65. Linking Words
examples: I practiced because I wanted to improve.
I was tired, but I continued.
conversation: First, I chose an idea. Then, I built the map.
No, it was difficult, but I continued.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 66. Opinion Language
examples: I think that English is useful.
In my opinion, teamwork is important.
conversation: What do you think about online lessons?
Do you agree that speaking is important?
Because speaking helps me use new words.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 67. Describing People: Character
examples: She is very responsible.
A good teammate should be polite and helpful.
conversation: What is your best friend like?
A good teammate should be responsible and polite.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 68. Problems & Safety
examples: My phone is broken.
It is unsafe to share your password.
conversation: Where did you see it last?
I saw it in the classroom.
You should report it to the teacher.
Good idea. I will do that now.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 69. Formal vs Informal English
examples: Could you help me, please?
I would like more information.

lessons.title: 🔸 Урок 70. Review & Assessment: Extended speaking test
grammar_patterns: I used to ____, but now I ____.
In my opinion, ____ is important because ____.
If I practice more, I will ____.
conversation: What have you learned this course?
I have learned how to speak about my experience.
What can you do better now?
I can explain my ideas better.
My goal is to speak more confidently.
I will practice every week and learn more words.
